experiments.single_lookup_guard: When type spread is exactly zero, substitute .5 for the otherwise unused type-noise fetch, retaining the original remaining expression. Both fair/mixed runs pass19/0, with apparent3.36%/2.73% paired GPU differences. Both overlap foreign headless Godot work; this marginal candidate has no isolated final qualification and is not promoted.
experiments.fixed_cumulus: Preserve the complete density body but compile a second version with type_=.5. Runtime dispatch selects it only when base==.5 and spread==0; all other inputs use the unchanged general body. Raw conditional prototype preserves all integration steps, textures and quadrature. It adds no cache, texture, resolution reduction or history.
experiments.direct_HDR: Current High integrator versus conditional fixed-cumulus density passes115/0:110 HDR scattering/transmittance comparisons over11 regional/weather/type cases,96/192 sample inputs and five origins below/inside/above the layer.901120 direct ray pixels; candidate changes zero pixels. This bypasses whole-sky subpass/composition behavior and does not override failed integrated controls.
experiments.whole_sky_limits: Mixed-weather full views fail strict controls, sometimes on the original as well as the candidate. At4K, recurring patterns include58 pixels with peak23/255 and5073 pixels with peak23/255; in the latter only5 pixels exceed2/255. These are not accepted differences or a proved driver defect. No threshold is relaxed.
experiments.unchanged_globals_control: Unchanged current High sky, fixed mixed weather, HDR viewport,5s preheat,40 captures. Quiet, identical full-frame uploads, vector-only uploads, texture-only uploads, then quiet all pass201/0. CPU cloud frame, source,2D noise bytes and texture identities remain exact. This does not reproduce the intermittent moving-to-held/variant-switch failure.
experiments.identical_source_ABBA: Two Shader objects with byte-identical original source pass20/0 through the moving clock and held capture sequence. Every arm has the same CPU cloud state, camera and projection. Recorded rendering-info counters are0; they do not demonstrate completion of sky pipeline compilation.
experiments.explicit_LOD: Both original-dome texture calls use the non-mipmapped filter_linear sampler inside per-pixel branches. An explicit textureLod(...,0) prototype still changes58 pixels between repeated candidate arms (peak23). This does not resolve the problem and is not promoted.

corrected_environment.finding: Initial copied sky-cost fixtures call EISky.update without the Environment. Null is deliberately conservative and retains volume rendering in the radiance cubemap even though Gfx.setup_original_env disables all radiance consumers. Actual Game calls EISky.update with _env (game.gd:514).
corrected_environment.correction: New background, explicit and bounds fixtures pass their real Environment at both setup/update calls and assert cloud_radiance==false in every arm. All sky geometry, half-resolution High integration and normal sky composition remain active. Four seconds of held settling are added outside timed intervals.
corrected_environment.scope: Controlled4K background-only sky, artificial fixed camera, procedural Ingos weather, fallback sky lighting and fancy sky enabled. Not a complete authored-map frame or whole-game FPS. Prior null-environment measurements remain valid only for their more expensive radiance-enabled fixture; do not compare absolute costs across these fixtures.

fixed_cumulus_fair.qualification: Promising fair-only result; not a production acceptance because mixed full-view controls fail.

accepted_existing_bounds.reference: Remove exactly Volume.sky_source() from the current full sky program and replace it with unchanged Volume.COMMON. Candidate is the already-accepted current High shader. No production edit.
accepted_existing_bounds.mixed: bounds-mixed01 fails23/1: current/unbounded programs differ at5073 pixels, peak23, while held/repeat/restored controls are exact in that run. This contradicts universal integrated pixel equivalence; retain the failure alongside earlier direct HDR equivalence and other original-program instability. It is not closed or attributed to a proven cause.

measurement_limits.method: ABBA, two program preheats of2.5s each,256 warm-up frames and360 GPU-timestamp samples per arm. Mean of arm medians. Early full-sky scopes include unnecessary cubemap volume; corrected scopes explicitly disable it through the real owner Environment.
measurement_limits.contention: Raw reports preserve every observed foreign process. Early runs overlap headless Godot work. Corrected runs record absolute sample intervals; the reported background-fair and all three bounds runs observe no other engine during any timed interval. This is process sampling at approximately0.25s, not proof that no other machine activity exists.
measurement_limits.pipeline_counters: Sky controls record scene draw/specialization counters at0. They are not evidence that all sky compilation has settled.
measurement_limits.packages: Existing engine/PCK/helper hashes are unchanged. No Android, Windows or affected-report-device runtime acceptance is claimed.

decisions_and_next_action: Keep all new type/LOD changes scratch-only. Preserve c34f19d, all earlier fixes, quality levels and independent cloud controls.
Use the corrected real-Environment fixture for future background-only sky cost comparisons; retain radiance-enabled cases separately when consumers exist.

Investigate GPU-observed shader inputs and sky subpass outputs during a failing mixed-weather transition. A same-frame probe can distinguish GPU input drift from generated-program/sky-composition differences. CPU frame snapshots and0 scene pipeline counters cannot decide this.
Do not repeat the same phase-hoist, type, light-exit or LOD probes as if untested. The fixed-cumulus math and fair saving are recorded; mixed integrated stability is the acceptance blocker.
Original Android/Linux reports, Windows/unavailable hardware acceptance and unrelated Mobile water flicker remain open. No playthroughs or unsolicited packages.
